title: Here’s What Democrats Plan to Do With Their Power if They Win Back Congress

title: Roy Cooper Has Never Lost an Election. Can He Flip North Carolina’s Senate Seat?

title: Israeli Settlers Turn a Palestinian Rite Into a Gantlet of Violence and Fear
